\makeatletter
% Observe real painters and their existing caller boundaries; do not stub them.
\newcount\OCformatted
\newcount\OCrejects
\newcount\OCwholetrials
\newcount\OCpreliminary
\newcount\OCpiececalls
\newcount\OChooks
\newcount\OCmeasurebase
\newcount\OCrejectbase
\newif\ifOCactive
\newif\ifOCpendingwhole
\newwrite\OCentries
\newwrite\OCeffects
\immediate\openout\OCentries=\jobname.entries
\immediate\openout\OCeffects=\jobname.effects
\def\OCerror#1{\PackageError{fitting-ownership}{#1}{Picture identity and copied-material ownership must be preserved.}}
\let\OCformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\OCformatted by1
  \protected@write\OCentries{}{ENTRY \the\dte@tnum:#1}%
  \OCformat{#1}}
\def\OChook{%
  \ifOCactive
    \ifnum\dte@piecenum=\OCexpected\relax\else
      \OCerror{Picture hook saw the wrong ordinal for \OCkind}\fi
    \global\advance\OChooks by1
    \typeout{OC-HOOK tree=\the\dte@tnum;kind=\OCkind;ordinal=\the\dte@piecenum}%
    \protected@write\OCeffects{}{PICTURE \the\dte@tnum:\OCkind:\the\dte@piecenum}%
  \fi}
\tikzset{every picture/.append style={execute at end picture={\OChook}}}
\let\OCsingle\dte@box@single
\def\dte@box@single#1#2{%
  \edef\OCexpected{\the\dte@piecenum}%
  \def\OCkind{assessment}%
  \ifx#2\dte@splitresult
    \def\OCkind{whole-trial}%
    \global\advance\OCwholetrials by1
  \else
    \global\advance\OCpreliminary by1
  \fi
  \OCactivetrue
  \OCsingle#1#2%
  \OCactivefalse
  % Even a counted whole trial has not advanced until this helper returns.
  \ifnum\dte@piecenum=\OCexpected\relax\else
    \OCerror{Whole helper advanced before its caller}\fi
  \ifx#2\dte@splitresult
    \edef\OCwholeexpected{\number\numexpr\dte@piecenum+1\relax}%
    \OCpendingwholetrue
  \fi}
\let\OCheight\dte@measureheight
\def\dte@measureheight#1{%
  \ifOCpendingwhole
    \ifnum\dte@piecenum=\OCwholeexpected\relax\else
      \OCerror{Whole trial did not advance after its picture}\fi
    \OCpendingwholefalse
  \fi
  \OCheight#1}
\let\OCdraw\dte@drawpiece
\def\dte@drawpiece#1{%
  \edef\OCexpected{\number\numexpr\dte@piecenum+1\relax}%
  \edef\OCkind{#1}%
  \OCactivetrue
  \OCdraw{#1}%
  \OCactivefalse
  \ifnum\dte@piecenum=\OCexpected\relax\else
    \OCerror{Split painter did not advance once}\fi}
\let\OCmeasure\dte@measurepiece
\def\dte@measurepiece#1{%
  \OCmeasurebase=\dte@piecenum
  \global\advance\OCpiececalls by1
  \OCmeasure{#1}%
  \ifnum\dte@piecenum=\numexpr\OCmeasurebase+1\relax\else
    \OCerror{Measurement advanced more than once}\fi}
\let\OCdiscard\dte@discardpiece
\def\dte@discardpiece{%
  \ifvoid\dte@tbox\OCerror{Discard called without a measured picture}\fi
  \edef\OCsourceextent{\the\wd\dte@framebox:\the\ht\dte@framebox:\the\dp\dte@framebox}%
  \OCrejectbase=\dte@piecenum
  \OCdiscard
  \ifvoid\dte@tbox\else\OCerror{Rejected picture retained}\fi
  \ifnum\dte@piecenum=\numexpr\OCrejectbase-1\relax\else
    \OCerror{Rejected ordinal not undone exactly once}\fi
  \edef\OCafterextent{\the\wd\dte@framebox:\the\ht\dte@framebox:\the\dp\dte@framebox}%
  \ifx\OCsourceextent\OCafterextent\else\OCerror{Rejection changed the source box}\fi
  \global\advance\OCrejects by1
  \typeout{OC-REJECT tree=\the\dte@tnum;ordinal=\the\dte@piecenum}}
\def\OCpositive#1{\ifnum#1>0\else\OCerror{Missing required path coverage}\fi}
\AtEndDocument{%
  \OCpositive\OCrejects \OCpositive\OCwholetrials
  \OCpositive\OCpreliminary \OCpositive\OCpiececalls \OCpositive\OChooks
  \ifOCpendingwhole\OCerror{Unfinished whole-picture bookkeeping}\fi
  \ifnum\OCformatted=87\else\OCerror{Semantic rows were lost or rebuilt}\fi
  \typeout{OC-COVERAGE formatted=\the\OCformatted;rejects=\the\OCrejects;whole=\the\OCwholetrials;preliminary=\the\OCpreliminary;pieces=\the\OCpiececalls;hooks=\the\OChooks}%
  \typeout{OC-ALL-CHECKS-PASSED}}
\makeatother

\makeatletter
\newcount\LSaccepts
\newcount\LSterminals
\newcount\LSdepth
\def\LSerror#1{\PackageError{lifecycle-owned-state}{#1}{Accept copied remainder without altering the chosen picture; finish copied terminals without requiring an empty source.}}
\def\LSboxstate#1{\ifvoid#1 X\else\ifhbox#1 H\else V\fi:\number\wd#1:\number\ht#1:\number\dp#1\fi}
\def\LSstate{\ifhmode H\else V\fi:\ifinner I\else O\fi:\number\currentgrouplevel:\the\dte@piecenum:\the\dte@defercount:\the\dte@pagecount:\number\dte@fitroom:\number\dte@fitht:\number\dte@availht}
\let\LSaccept\dte@acceptsplit
\def\dte@acceptsplit{%
  \edef\LSremainder{\LSboxstate\dte@extbox}%
  \edef\LSpicture{\LSboxstate\dte@tbox}%
  \edef\LSrows{\LSboxstate\dte@splitresult}%
  \edef\LSbefore{\LSstate}%
  \LSaccept
  \ifvoid\dte@extbox\else\LSerror{Accepted remainder was not consumed}\fi
  \edef\LSafter{\LSboxstate\dte@framebox}%
  \ifx\LSafter\LSremainder\else\LSerror{Wrong canonical remainder}\fi
  \edef\LSafter{\LSboxstate\dte@tbox}%
  \ifx\LSafter\LSpicture\else\LSerror{Acceptance altered the measured picture}\fi
  \edef\LSafter{\LSboxstate\dte@splitresult}%
  \ifx\LSafter\LSrows\else\LSerror{Acceptance altered the chosen rows}\fi
  \edef\LSafter{\LSstate}%
  \ifx\LSafter\LSbefore\else\LSerror{Acceptance changed mode, group, counters or fitting values}\fi
  \global\advance\LSaccepts by1
  \typeout{LS-ACCEPT tree=\the\dte@tnum;ordinal=\the\dte@piecenum;remainder=\LSremainder}}
\let\LScont\dte@dosplit@cont
\def\dte@dosplit@cont{%
  \advance\LSdepth by1
  \LScont
  \ifx\dte@piecetype\dte@plast\else\LSerror{Continuation returned without terminal completion}\fi
  \ifvoid\dte@tbox\else\LSerror{Accepted measured picture was not consumed}\fi
  \ifnum\dte@defercount=0\else\LSerror{Successful output did not reset deferral}\fi
  \ifvoid\dte@framebox\else
    \global\advance\LSterminals by1
    \typeout{LS-TERMINAL tree=\the\dte@tnum;depth=\the\LSdepth;ordinal=\the\dte@piecenum;source=\LSboxstate\dte@framebox}%
  \fi
  \advance\LSdepth by-1}
\AtEndDocument{%
  \ifnum\LSaccepts=5\else\LSerror{Missing accepted copied-prefix coverage}\fi
  \ifnum\LSterminals=5\else\LSerror{Missing populated-source terminal returns}\fi
  \ifnum\LSdepth=0\else\LSerror{Unfinished continuation}\fi
  \typeout{LS-ALL-CHECKS-PASSED accepts=5;terminal-returns=5}}
\makeatother
